title: Samsung Galaxy A16 released in Pakistan: Check specs, price
excerpt: Samsung Galaxy A16 released in Pakistan: Check specs, price
content:
Samsung has officially unveiled its latest mid-range smartphone, the Samsung Galaxy A16, in Pakistan. The device was first introduced globally in October and is now available locally in Grey, Water Green, and Midnight Blue color options.

Key Features

The Samsung Galaxy A16 boasts a 6.7-inch full-HD+ AMOLED display with a smooth 90Hz refresh rate, making it perfect for streaming and gaming. The screen resolution is 1080p FHD+, offering crisp and vibrant visuals.

Under the hood, the phone is powered by the Helio G99 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. It also comes with six years of OS and security updates, ensuring support until 2030.

Battery and Camera

The Galaxy A16 features a robust 5,000mAh battery with 25W fast charging, providing up to 2.5 days of playback time on a single charge.

For photography enthusiasts, the phone includes a triple rear camera setup:

  • 50MP main sensor
  • 5MP ultra-wide lens
  • 2MP macro camera

On the front, there’s a 13MP selfie camera for high-quality selfies and video calls.

Samsung Galaxy A16 price in Pakistan

The Galaxy A16 is available in two variants:

  • 6GB RAM + 128GB storage: Rs54,999
  • 8GB RAM + 256GB storage: Rs61,999

With its powerful performance, impressive display, and long-term software support, the Samsung Galaxy A16 is a solid option in the mid-range smartphone market.
